correctness.rationale: The proof partitions every proper crown vertex subset into disjoint alternating runs, classifies all path-poset component types including singleton and odd-path endpoint parity, counts each labeled subset with the exact cyclic factor n/t using a two-state matrix, and multiplies squared profile inventories by the full direct-product/wreath component automorphism order. The full crown contributes exactly 2n. High-rank coefficients are rederived by independent two-deletion distance classes. verify.py exhaustively checks all partial bijections on 4, 6 and 8 vertices and all induced-subset profile multiplicities through 16 vertices. These finite tests are supporting evidence only, and no step claims they prove an infinite case.

value.rationale: The complete element-by-domain-rank distribution of a natural inverse semigroup is a canonical filtration invariant beyond its established minimal-generator rank. The result determines every rank ideal cardinality in the finite crown family, gives a uniform finite matrix/log-determinant computation with nontrivial cyclic parity constraints, and supplies sharp codimension-one and codimension-two counts with an essential small-crown exception. It is not just a relabeling of the uncolored cycle graph formula, which predicts a different codimension-one coefficient.
